title: Image grader and pack
acceptance: Grader as decided, deterministic for a fixed model and seed; fixtures that pass and fail
examples/image-generation-v1.json, area audio-video, regression and holdout splits; index entry
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Failing pack test first; fixture for each acceptance item; npm test; npm run check:index; CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 in the domain-packs plan (owner request) at observed agent speed for one-PR pack steps. Not a measurement.
